$comment: The single registry of what actually exists. Both apps/web and apps/site read it, so a 'Coming soon' label cannot rot after a feature ships or slips. status is built | in-progress | planned. Public copy may only describe a feature in the PRESENT TENSE when its status is 'built' — see CONTEXT.md §6. Update this file in the same commit as any change to what a feature does.
phase: 0 — merge and scaffold complete; Phase 1 (data, auth, API) is next

features.name: Quick capture
features.publicCopy: A thought, saved in seconds — no title, no folder, no decision.

features.name: Voice to text
features.publicCopy: Speak instead of type when typing feels like too much. Your words become editable text as you go.
features.note: Works in the demo on this site, in browsers that support the Web Speech API. Not yet in the app.

features.name: Light structure, no toolbar
features.publicCopy: Simple formatting that stays out of the way. Structure when you want it; plain text when you don't.

features.name: Summaries
features.publicCopy: Turn a long, messy note into its key points, so review is possible even at low attention. The original is always kept.
features.note: The summariser itself is written and tested, and you can try it in the demo on this site. Wiring it to a saved note is the work in progress.

features.name: Action items
features.publicCopy: Pull the “I need to email Sam” out of a wall of notes and turn it into something you can act on.
features.note: Extraction is written and tested; the list view across your notes is the work in progress.

features.name: Suggested tags
features.publicCopy: The app proposes organisation so you don't have to. Every suggestion is optional and dismissible.

features.name: Listen back
features.publicCopy: Play a note aloud instead of reading it, for the times reading is the hard part.

features.name: Search that finds it
features.publicCopy: Search matches what a note says, not what you happened to call it.
features.note: The ranking is written and tested — try it in the demo. Running it over your own notes is the work in progress.

features.name: Pin, archive, tag
features.publicCopy: Lightweight triage for the notes that matter now versus later.

features.name: Reminders
features.publicCopy: Gentle nudges tied to what a note is about — not another wall of red badges.

features.name: Sharing
features.publicCopy: Share a note with read or edit access, for study groups and shared projects.

features.name: Readable fonts
features.publicCopy: A legibility-first default face, with OpenDyslexic one tap away.
features.note: Both fonts are live on this site — try the toggles in the footer. Not yet in the app.

features.name: Calm themes
features.publicCopy: Light, dark, high-contrast, and a low-stimulation mode — match the interface to what you can handle right now.

features.name: Focus mode
features.publicCopy: One note, nothing else on screen.
features.note: Live in the demo on the home page. The version inside the app is a port of that same component.

features.name: Motion off
features.publicCopy: Turn off animation entirely, whatever your operating system is set to.
features.note: Live on this site — the toggle is in the footer. Not yet in the app.

features.name: Settings that follow you
features.publicCopy: Set the interface once and it follows you to every device.

features.name: Accounts
features.publicCopy: Your own account, with your notes visible only to you.

features.name: Cloud sync
features.publicCopy: Phone to laptop mid-sentence. Nothing to save, nothing to lose.

features.name: Offline capture
features.publicCopy: Capture with no connection, and let it sync when you next have one.

features.name: AI assistance
features.publicCopy: Optional, off by default. Turn it on and your note text is sent to Anthropic to produce a stronger summary; leave it off and nothing ever leaves our servers.

features.name: Export everything
features.publicCopy: Download every note and setting you have, as plain JSON, whenever you want.

features.name: Delete everything
features.publicCopy: Delete your account and everything in it, in one action.

features.name: Published accessibility audit
features.publicCopy: A dated conformance statement naming what conforms, what doesn't yet, and how to report a barrier.
features.note: WCAG 2.1 AA is the target. No conformance claim will be made before the audit has actually run.
